entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: ¶Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: How long [will it be ere] ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, [and] reputed vile in your sight?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place? {himself: Heb. his soul}

words.text: for thee? and shall the rock

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: ¶Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him. {candle: or, lamp}

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: The gin shall take [him] by the heel, [and] the robber shall prevail against him.

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: The snare [is] laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way. {laid: Heb. hidden}

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: ¶Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet. {drive: Heb. scatter}

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction [shall be] ready at his side.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: It shall devour the strength of his skin: [even] the firstborn of death shall devour his strength. {strength: Heb. bars}

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because [it is] none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

words.text: , and he shall have no name

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world. {He...: Heb. They shall drive him}

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: They that come after [him] shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted. {went...: or, lived with him} {were...: Heb. laid hold on horror}

words.text: . {went...: or, lived with him} {were...: Heb. laid hold on horror}

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Surely such [are] the dwellings of the wicked, and this [is] the place [of him that] knoweth not God.
